entities.text:
High Court Of Madhya Pradesh
 At Jabalpur
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Heard on I.A. No. 11881 of 2025, which is first application under Section 430 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023, for suspension of sentence and grant of bail to appellant No.2- Omkar Rai @ Bholu.

The appellant is aggrieved of the judgment dated 07/10/2024 passed by learned Special Judge,
POCSO Act and Third Additional Sessions Judge, District Umariya (M.P.), in Special Case No.20/2021, whereby the appellant has been convicted for offences under Section 376(D) of the Indian Penal Code and sentenced to undergo R.I. for 20 years with fine of Rs.1,000/- and Section 506(2) of the Indian Penal Code and sentenced to undergo R.I. for 5 years with fine of Rs.1,000/-
and in default of payment of fine amount further RI for 6 months.

entities.text: Third Additional Sessions Judge, District Umariya (M.P.)
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the appellant submits that the appellant is innocent and has been falsely implicated in this case.

It is further submitted that the case of present appellant is on the same footing as that of co-accused Manu Kewat and Itrendra Singh, who have been enlarged on bail by order of this Court vide order dated 26/08/2025 passed in connected CRA No. 2 CRA-11915-2024 12154/2024 & CRA No.13554/2024 pointing out that the DNA report is positive only qua Vivek Yadav.
There are good chances of success in appeal.
The final disposal of the appeal would take considerable time.
He, therefore, prays for suspension of sentence and grant of bail to the appellant.
Learned Government Advocate opposes the prayer and prays for dismissal of the same.

After hearing learned counsel for the parties and going through the record as also maintaining principle of parity, without commenting on the merits of the case, we are of the considered opinion that this is a fit case to suspend the remaining jail sentence of the appellant and to release him on Akash Singh Maravi @ Lala vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 6 October, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/142854221/
1 bail.

entities.text: Akash Singh Maravi @ Lala vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Accordingly, I.A. No. 21371 of 2025 is allowed.

It is directed that on depositing of the fine amount, if not already deposited and on furnishing personal bond to the tune of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand Only) with two sureties in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court for his appearance before the Trial Court on 15/12/2025 and on all subsequent dates as may be fixed by the concerned Court, the execution of remaining part of jail sentence of appellant Omkar Rai @ Bholu shall remain suspended and he be released on bail till final disposal of this appeal.
List the matter along with CRA No. 13554 of 2024.
